## About

Dr Richard William McLean (known as Barran Dodger) is a disabled LGBTQ+ whistleblower, PhD holder, internationally celebrated author, and UNHCR-verified asylum seeker internally displaced within Australia. Over 35 years, he has been systematically persecuted by 35+ Australian government agencies. He survived 14 forced psychiatric hospitalisations across 3 states, assassination attempts, and was found with no pulse (2.87% survival probability). The Australian Attorney-General was formally notified in 2021 and chose silence.

The Barran Dodger Legal & Ethical Trust Fund (ABN 78 833 496 164) was established to document this persecution through blockchain-verified evidence that cannot be altered, denied, or destroyed.
